sources.supports: Most emigrants walked beside their wagons; aims of 20 miles contrasted with more typical 10-15 mile progress and 5-6 months.
sources.limits: School synthesis, not a daily 1848 survey or a walking-without-supplies survival rate.

sources.supports: Observed mean adult daily walking 7.6 km women, 12.9 km men, in the studied foraging ecology; patterns vary with tasks and landscape.
sources.limits: Search loops and camp activity, not maximum marching distance. No transfer of group averages to game ethnicity or sex stats; no direct 1848 climate or food-yield analogue.

sources.supports: Measured energy expenditure and walking; high habitual activity did not imply simple unlimited increases in total expenditure.
sources.limits: Small population-specific sample; not a direct conversion of game pounds into calories or a daily survival guarantee.

sources.supports: Human food acquisition depends on high-intensity work, sophisticated techniques, cooperation and sharing; returns can be high and variable.
sources.limits: Does not justify guaranteed meat every outing or infer that Western trail greens alone meet all energy needs.

sources.supports: Added backpack load increases mechanical work and metabolic cost.
sources.limits: Fixed-speed smooth treadmill setting; cannot establish one long-haul emigrant pace or a linear health-to-capacity formula.

sources.supports: A highly fit young adult completed a 112-day 2019 hike with repeated resupply, substantial exertion and foot problems.
sources.limits: One selected athlete, modern gear and town food; not a default family pace or evidence for living from hunting alone.

sources.supports: Human physiology adapts to food deprivation over time; hunger cannot be represented as immediate loss of all reserves.
sources.limits: Clinical setting, not a safe fasting duration or mortality schedule for ill/exposed emigrants. Exact game damage/debt values remain authored.

sources.date: 2024 Army professional article summarizing ATP 3-21.18; indexed text checked, full-page access: 403
sources.supports: Indexed figure summary reports 20-32 km/day and different road/cross-country march rates.
sources.limits: Conditioned military context, not a civilian target. Full page inaccessible in this pass; used only as a secondary cross-check, not the primary calibration anchor.
